title: Staffage Human Collection Wave
description: Extend the architectural staffage catalog (🎓️teaching/🏛️architecture/🧍️staffage/🗂️catalog/👤️humans) with a huge collection of new handcrafted people (work, hospitality, care, construction, children, elderly, sports, mobility, leisure, culture, chores, services, accessibility, weather, crowds, logistics) via a massive parallel wave of Opus 5.5 agents, each asset passing the staffage check, with manifest rows, collections and tests synced.
summary: 47 new people are in the staffage catalog and manifest (75 humans), with five new collections and two extended ones. All 47 pass the product check CLI, the schema, the three-views pose-and-clip sweep, catalog physics, breathing and power suites (2026-11-23). Not clean: the catalog-silhouette guard (2D drawing against 3D volume) is still red for 22 of the 47 (most only at 1:50 by 16 to 36 mm against 15 mm, dancer at every scale); several people keep print range-end findings in the full validator; the fixes are repair ops on top of the generators and the generators were not all re-run; not every sheet was opened. Never started and left unstarted by the dev's order: hotel-receptionist, carer-pushing-wheelchair, yoga-practitioner, inline-skater, window-cleaner, security-guard, gardener-with-wheelbarrow. The silhouette remainder is carried by the open 3D ticket 26/11/14. Evidence: state-at-close.md in the ticket and humans-a.md, humans-b.md, humans-a-repair.md, humans-b-repair.md, three-views-3.md in ticket 26/11/22/GET-STAFFAGE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AND-FINISH-ALL-STAFFAGE-TICKETS.

interactions.prompt: Use as massive wave of Opus 5.5. agents to extend the staffage with huge collection of people. Start wave immediately as fast as you can.
